capabilities.claim: the economy settles and conserves its own money
the ledger's chain is re-computed and verified by an independent auditor
the network's full state is capsule-backed, sandbox-wipe-surviving
the fleet heals its own nodes (keeper daemon + watchdog)
the architecture schedules its own work (20 enabled schedules)
capabilities.detail: 20 schedules all carry live nextRunAt promises

capabilities.claim: the architecture red-teams its own claims on a schedule
an LLM brain trades inside the laws and its P&L is measured against the algorithms
prices are anchored to real external markets, not to the system's own claims
lane work is preserved remotely (archive tag peel == live HEAD)
a rotated credential placed in the supply path is ingested by the scheduled backup itself
capabilities.detail: pat.env carries a usable token (self-ingested by control-plane-backup)

capabilities.claim: the owner's identity and standing intents are structurally remembered by the money node itself — even in the owner's absence
the architecture makes and journals owner-grade decisions on its own schedule — hold decisions recorded exactly like actions
every byte we push is content-scanned against 7 high-confidence secret patterns before it can leave — a token inside a .md can no longer pass

gaps.requires: human-owner — one physical host carries the whole network; its loss needs a new host
gaps.mitigation: state capsules (15-min cadence) + git refs + start-nodes.sh universal seed + daily dr-drill
gaps.detail: dr-drill last=succeeded — restore-on-new-host is drilled, but the host itself is beyond the architecture's reach

gaps.requires: human-owner — GitHub account ownership, PAT issuance, domains, legal/tax identity
gaps.mitigation: rotated credentials are auto-ingested from the supply path (capability 10)
gaps.detail: issuance itself is a third-party act — the architecture cannot be its own registrar

gaps.requires: human-owner — funds held outside this ledger on real-world rails
gaps.mitigation: honesty law R36 — the custodial backing ratio is always shown next to the mirror-law solvency
gaps.detail: custodial backing=12.01% — moving external money is a human-world act; the system tells the truth about it instead of pretending

gaps.requires: human-owner — a single shared egress IP; no sovereign networking layer
gaps.mitigation: none built yet — this gap is open by honest declaration
gaps.detail: sovereign networking (own IPs/ASN/tunnels) was not built; pretending otherwise would be the lie this matrix exists to prevent

gaps.requires: human-owner — private keys live only on this host; a host loss means re-licensing identity
gaps.mitigation: private PEMs are excluded from capsules by law; identity is restored by operator re-license
gaps.detail: deliberate: keys never travel in capsules — the manifest documents the boundary
